hints.title: Prefix and Suffix Partitioning
hints.text: A valid pair nums[i] and nums[j] requires nums[i] to match a prefix of target and nums[j] to match the corresponding remaining suffix.

hints.title: Split Point Enumeration
hints.text: Iterate across all split positions from index one to length of target minus one, separating target into candidate prefix and suffix.

hints.title: Frequency Product with Same-String Correction
hints.text: Count matching prefix and suffix counts from a frequency map. If prefix equals suffix, subtract count to disallow using the same index twice.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.time: O(N * L + T^2) where N is array length, L is string length, and T is target length
complexity.space: O(N * L) for frequency hash map of strings
variables: N: number of strings in nums
complexity.notes: Iterating over prefix splits of target is bounded by target length.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Nested pairwise loop over 1000 strings takes O(N^2 * L) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Hashing string frequencies reduces quadratic search to target length splits.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should iterate over target splits rather than all pairs of strings.
